home.heroSubtitle: Transforming historical and physical land cadastral documents into tamper-proof, AI-validated digital records across Maharashtra and India.
home.featuresSubtitle: End-to-end automated pipeline integrating multilingual OCR, cadastral shape verification, and revenue officer validation.

about.title: Modernizing Historical Land Records with Cadastral AI
about.description: ILRDVS is designed to bridge historical paper records (Modi script, archaic Marathi, and revenue formats) with modern digital land registries, ensuring every land parcel is securely geo-referenced and tamper-proof.
about.mission: Our Mission: 100% digital transparency, zero boundary disputes, and instant citizen access to certified 7/12 extracts.
about.vision: A unified cadastral spatial registry powering citizen empowerment and ease of governance.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find immediate answers regarding 7/12 extracts, mutation applications, and AI verification.
faq.q1: How does the AI OCR digitization work?
faq.a1: Our vision models process scanned Marathi and English land records to transcribe survey numbers, khata details, and boundaries for citizen review and Talathi approval.
faq.q2: What should I do if a discrepancy is detected?
faq.a2: You will receive an alert on your Citizen Portal. Simply review the flagged variance and submit your clarification or supporting tax receipt directly to the officer.
faq.a3: Yes. Approved records carry digital government signatures and QR codes compliant with the Information Technology Act.
